name: HK417
description:
An Eisenmarkian battle rifle incorporating the designs of the AR-10 and M416 featuring a proprietary receiver and ambidextrous controls, famous for its worldwide use by police forces.
Packs a punch throughout distance with moderate firerate but makes recoil control and reloads difficult with its bulky ergonomics.
Switch to semi for improved accuracy!

Model submitted by Rialag.
